frontiers.question: Does entity-owned project state survive replacement?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Independent two-host receipt, old-writer exclusion and capability requalification; no automatic distributed ownership.

frontiers.question: Does counterevidence change behavior rather than only autobiography?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: External contradiction sequence with dependent procedures; compare against a non-revising baseline.

frontiers.question: Does verified feedback produce useful future changes?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Prospective prediction receipts, independently checked reference equations and real pilot outcomes.

frontiers.question: Does structural reuse outperform retrieval or answer caching under cost accounting?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Fresh numerical inputs, finite-domain labels, complete acquisition cost and matched memory/cache controls.

frontiers.question: Do reusable abstractions reduce later learning effort?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: General semantic abstractions, larger grammars, independently novel families and held-out acquisition-efficiency comparisons; not a DreamCoder replication.

frontiers.question: Can the entity distinguish observation from intervention?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Independent intervention oracle; observationally equivalent graph alternatives and counterfactual abduction are future work.

frontiers.question: Does competence calibration improve decisions?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Measure calibration, routing regret and new-mechanism recovery, not a self-description score.

frontiers.question: Do different histories produce distinct transferable organizations?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Implement curriculum-specific exposure matrices and shared novel endpoints; no mathematician/engineer divergence claim yet.

frontiers.question: Do learned structures survive an LLM swap?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Two independently qualified pinned organs, nonzero registered organ_swap count, preserved frozen state and cost calibration.

frontiers.question: Does total verified utility improve after accounting for physical costs?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Actual energy/memory instruments, per-machine qualification and equal-endowment comparisons; no additive mixed-unit score.

frontiers.question: Can the entity learn from real literature, proofs and systems projects?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Actual isolated repository, formal, perception and simulation dispatchers plus hidden independent oracles. No external apprenticeship has run.

frontiers.question: Can it select and generate useful novel challenges?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: World proposal/admission interface, novelty/solvability controls, anti-curriculum-gaming tests and paired transfer studies.

frontiers.question: Can verified experience improve a replaceable neural organ?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Qualified local model/environment, authorized fitting, actual retention outcomes and service artifact binding; full Hawking fitting/compiler ABI remains unimplemented.

frontiers.question: Does a multi-year entity retain and reorganize competence?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Long-lived retention/interference, revocation, storage lifecycle, recovery and distributed writer policy; no elapsed years can be scaffolded into evidence.

frontiers.question: Do recurrent viewpoint-bound broadcasts causally coordinate behavior?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Paired workspace/recurrence/perspective lesions, nontrivial information routing, learned multimodal representations and independent outcomes. A small programmed broadcaster does not satisfy every theoretical indicator.

frontiers.question: Do self predictions and intervention-based attribution generalize?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Independent action/control instruments, calibration across unfamiliar mechanisms, source attribution and actual agency studies.

frontiers.question: How do organization, history, tensors and executable regions change with ability?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Matched capability/retention studies, assets and residency instrumentation, actual Hawking ABI adaptation, full transition/state fidelity and hardware lowering.

frontiers.question: Does one continuing program support the full semi-conscious general-intelligence target?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: All internal chapter outcomes, generality and causal indicator evidence on the same qualified lineage, independent synthesis and responsible phenomenal/welfare interpretation. No count of indicators is a consciousness proof.

frontiers.question: Can attributed local data improve daily use without becoming unverified knowledge?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Qualify real local organs, privacy boundaries, answer quality and source-use faithfulness; current loader accepts UTF-8, not general multimedia.

frontiers.question: Does selecting memory, structural reuse or neural change improve later learning?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Current allocator is heuristic. Replay selection and template mining are implemented; learned optimal allocation and autonomous neural consolidation are not established.

frontiers.question: Do independently verified partial observations improve a recurrent predictive state?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Small normalized action-conditioned tanh dynamics; external encoders, multiscale latent learning, calibrated causal counterfactuals and broad perception remain obligations.

frontiers.question: Can learned changes improve retained competence without corrupting lineage?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Independent actual retention and transfer measurements; rollback of artifacts is not certified unlearning of all descendants.

frontiers.question: Can reviewed skills transfer without private data or inherited authority?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Only reviewed closed-program capsules, local witnesses and separate qualification; no automatic full-personal checkpoint market or general semantic merging.

frontiers.question: Can every needed Hawking subsystem be inherited under a source/state/runtime contract?
frontiers.remaining_obligation: Pinned source staging and a proposed capability ABI are implemented; dependency closure, compilation, backend adaptation, host fidelity and actual runtime qualification remain explicit.
